{{Top|leg}}
'''Kolln''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Kolln relayed some rumors about [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Outlaw tech/Legends|outlaw techs]] making reproductions of [[auto-caster]]s and arming their security personnel with them.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
